messages:
Maya Chen: FYI a customer says their trial promo landed on a stale org that they can't access. They signed up twice and the credits went to the first org that has a different billing admin. Details below.
Support Bot: Ticket created #CS-4321. Please include org_id, email, and a screenshot if possible.
Liam Ortiz: Thanks Maya — can you paste the affected org_id and the user email? Also any invite/ownership emails? :thinking:
Maya Chen: org_id: org_0a1b2c3d, account email: user+trial@acme.com. They say they deleted the first workspace but it still exists as a 'legacy' org with no admins.
Olivia Park: Do they see the org in the console? If no admins, they might not be able to claim it. We should check if it is in 'deactivated' state or just orphaned.
Maya Chen: They sent a screenshot showing two orgs w/ similar names. They clicked billing -> credits shows 1000 trial tokens attached to org_0a1b2c3d (legacy). Current active org is org_9z8y7x6w.
Liam Ortiz: Ok. Quick triage plan: 1) verify both orgs in DB, 2) confirm promo record linked to legacy org, 3) if orphaned, either transfer credits to new org or re-issue promo. Need billing sign-off for transfer.
Rajesh Kumar: I can pull the promo record. If it's still marked 'redeemed' we may reassign. Send me the promo code or redemption id.
Maya Chen: Promo code: REDWOOD-TRIAL-2026, redemption_id: redm_55f4e6. Attached screenshot: shows billing page with amount "1000 credit". They need credits on org_9z8y7x6w asap — blocked on dev testing.
Rajesh Kumar: Found it. promo REDWOOD-TRIAL-2026 -> redm_55f4e6 -> linked_org org_0a1b2c3d. Status: redeemed. Org org_0a1b2c3d has no admins. We can either transfer balance or set up admin claim flow. Recommend transfer for speed.
Billing Team: We approve manual transfer for trial promo in this case. Please confirm the destination org_id and that the requester is verified owner.
Maya Chen: Confirmed destination org_9z8y7x6w and requester email user+trial@acme.com (we have org admin invite trace). They provided a screenshot of invite acceptance.
Liam Ortiz: I'll create a migration job: copy credit balance 1000 -> org_9z8y7x6w and set a note on redm_55f4e6. Scheduled in next 30 mins. Will post logs here.
Support Bot: Job cs-migrate-1769456789 started by Liam Ortiz.
Liam Ortiz: Migration complete. cs-migrate-1769456789: success. Credits moved to org_9z8y7x6w. Updated redemption record and notified billing. :white_check_mark:
Olivia Park: Can the customer confirm they see credits in the active workspace now?
Maya Chen: Customer confirmed, credits present and tests unblocked. Marking resolved. :tada:
